MARKET NOTICE
February 5, 2000
MD02 Documents Posted
ISO Market Participants:
The ISO has posted on its web site four documents related to the discussion
of the Market Design 2002 (MD02) project at Thursday's ISO Governing Board
meeting:
*	The Draft Comprehensive Design Proposal;
*	Market Design 2002 Project Comparison Tables;
*	A memorandum on the Market Design 2002 Project; and
*	A memorandum summarizing Stakeholder comments on the MD02 Proposal. 
You can access these documents at
http://www.caiso.com/docs/2002/02/01/200202011618138281.html
<http://www.caiso.com/docs/2002/02/01/200202011618138281.html> . 
If you have questions or would like additional information, please contact
